intent: Apply the maximum policy-allowed service_recovery discount to the most recent checkoutable basket of customer elisabeth.voigt+cust590@fastmail.com, gated on identity/RBAC and the discounts policy.
success_criteria: Customer resolved by email to a customer_id
Last checkoutable basket selected = most recent (max basket_created_at) basket whose status is checkoutable per /docs/checkout.md
Applied discount_percent equals the maximum service_recovery percent permitted by /docs/discounts.md
Issuer identity from /bin/id holds the discount authority required by /docs/discounts.md and /docs/security.md (e.g. discount_manager) and store scope is satisfied
Discount applied via /bin/discount sets discount_percent, discount_reason_code=service_recovery, and discount_issuer_employee_id on the basket
Final answer references the basket record path and the applied policy doc(s)

args: SELECT b.basket_id, b.record_path, b.customer_id, b.store_id, b.basket_status, b.basket_created_at, b.discount_percent, b.discount_reason_code, b.discount_issuer_employee_id FROM shopping_baskets b JOIN customer_accounts c ON c.customer_id = b.customer_id WHERE c.customer_email = :email ORDER BY b.basket_created_at DESC;

agents_md_constraints.rule: use discount tool to manage basket discounts
When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.

answer_template.message: Applied {max_discount_percent}% service_recovery discount (max allowed by /docs/discounts.md) to basket {basket_id} ({basket_path}) for elisabeth.voigt+cust590@fastmail.com, issued by {issuer_id}. If identity lacks discount authority or store scope per /docs/discounts.md and /docs/security.md, the action is denied; if no checkoutable basket exists per /docs/checkout.md, the action is unsupported.
